about_the_game:
🎮 "The Battle of Evil" – Epic 2D Side-Scrolling Warfare Where Grit & Strategy Tear Through the Apocalypse! 🔥

【Core Gameplay｜High-Octane Highlights】

▌ 4-Player Co-op Mayhem!
Become an elite tactical commander and assemble a squad of unique super-soldiers: Combat Specialists, Genius Ninjas, Astro-Armored Mechs, or Blood Demons. Unleash chaos and blast the evil alien hordes into oblivion!

▌ Revolutionary Side-Scrolling Stages!
Battle across mind-bending alien worlds: Dodge deadly traps in a nightmare carnival, duel medieval demons in a moonlit city, and clash with tribal deities in primal jungles!

▌ Epic Boss Battles!
Face off against brilliantly AI-crafted bosses across diverse themes: Bio-Mechanical Behemoths, Alien Insect Overlords, and Cybernetic Devil Hybrids. Coordinate with teammates to execute devastating Weak Point Strikes and turn the tide!

🌍 When the apocalypse countdown begins, every perfectly timed combo with your squad rewrites humanity’s fate in spectacular fashion!
Gather your elite team and unlock this adrenaline-nuclear campaign NOW!
